ar-followup.name: AR Followup
ar-followup.description: Age AR with their buckets and produce a questions pack. Do not write off, apply payments, or email customers unless they asked.

bank-reconcile.name: Bank Reconcile
bank-reconcile.description: Match one named statement to the books and write a rec pack that shows the difference. Do not plug to force a zero.

bank-review.name: Bank Review
bank-review.description: Flag unclear bank lines, transfers, owner deposits, and processor names. Next step is their answers, not a silent recode.

contractor-1099-year.name: Contractor 1099 Year
contractor-1099-year.description: Build a contractor payment list for a year they name. No TINs, no e-file, no worker-classification opinion.

credit-card-code.name: Credit Card Code
credit-card-code.description: Code one card statement period and flag personal-looking charges and missing receipts. Do not pay the card.

job-cost-light.name: Job Cost Light
job-cost-light.description: Tag bills and costs to job ids they already use. No invented jobs, markup, or overhead rates.

month-end.name: Month End
month-end.description: Close notes for one named period: rec status, open questions, and a short close pack. Do not call the month closed if a rec is open.

receipt-match.name: Receipt Match
receipt-match.description: Index receipts and match them to card or bank lines. Unmatched items stay exceptions.

sales-tax-questions.name: Sales Tax Questions
sales-tax-questions.description: List tax collected as they marked from their sales file. Never invent a rate, nexus, or a filed return.

vendor-bills.name: Vendor Bills
vendor-bills.description: Index vendor bills and code them to their chart or a labeled guess. This role never originates payment.
